jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Full Stack Software Engineer

What you will do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role you will contribute to the development and maintenance of our web applications by working on both front-end and back-end technologies. This role is ideal for early-career professionals looking to take on challenges in software development.

Develop and maintain front-end applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks, preferably ReactJS.

Develop and manage back-end services using languages such as Python or Node.js, leveraging AWS cloud infrastructure.

Experience building or integrating applications with generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG patterns, or AI orchestration frameworks.

Create innovative solutions leveraging the latest technologies.

Collaborate with the design and product teams to understand user needs and translate them into technical requirements.

Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code.

Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.

Maintain system uptime and optimal performance

Learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The software professional we seek will have these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Masters degree

OR

Bachelors degree and 2 years of software development experience

Or

Associates degree and 6 years of software development experience

Or

High school diploma / GED and 8 years of software development experience

Preferred Qualifications

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills

Hands on experience with web development, proficient with HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Hands on experience with backend development, proficient with SQL/NoSQL database, proficient in Python and SQL

Ability to learn new technologies quickly. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

Experienced with API integration, serverless, microservices architecture.

Experience building or integrating applications with generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG patterns, or AI orchestration frameworks.

Experience in SQL/NOSQL database, vector database for large language models

Experience with popular large language models

Experience with various frameworks like Langchain or llamaIndex for developing applications

Experience with prompt engineering, model fine tuning

Experience with DevOps CICD build and deployment pipeline

Experience with design patterns, data structures, test-driven development.

Education And Professional Certifications

Bachelors degree in computer science and engineering preferred, other Engineering field is considered.

Cloud Computing certificate preferred

Soft Skills

Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams

High degree of initiative and self-motivation.

Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.

Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

Strong presentation and public speaking skills.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In Addition To The Base Salary, Amgen Offers a Total Rewards Plan, Based On Eligibility, Comprising Of Health And Welfare Plans For Staff And Eligible Dependents, Financial Plans With Opportunities To Save Towards Retirement Or Other Goals, Work/life Balance, And Career Development Opportunities That May Include

A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

Stock-based long-term incentives

Award-winning time-off plans

Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Advanced Weapons
has an opening for an Object Oriented Software Test Engineer 2/3
with an active clearance, to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. The selected candidate for this position is required to be on-site at our Northridge, CA
location . Relocation assistance, while not guaranteed, may be available.

As an integral part of our multi-discipline engineering team in the Advanced Weapons division, you will be on the forefront of developing next-generation solutions to protect technology for our nation’s warfighters. The ideal candidate will be supporting one of our programs for defining and architecting a secured missile weapon system. This position may require collaboration with team members of other disciplines, such as software and systems engineering within the organization for requirements validity.

Roles And Responsibilities

A successful candidate will have the qualities and essential functional expertise with:

Author Software Test Plans, Procedures, Subsystem Acceptance Test Procedures, and Test Reports.
Generate test artifacts for developmental, integration, qualification, and acceptance testing.
Develop automated test approaches for new software capabilities.
Compile test data, identify gaps, and recommend procedural changes.
Perform hands‑on troubleshooting and support organic/COTS SW/HW integration in the labs.
Working with SW development teams to document and resolve SW issues.

Basic Qualifications for a Software Engineer level (T02) and Principal Engineer level(T03):

US Citizenship and Active DoD Secret Clearance.
For Software Integration and Test Engineer: Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline and 2+ years of experience or Master's degree in a STEM discipline and 0 years of experience.
For Principal Integration and Test Engineer: Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline and 5+ years of experience or Master's degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of experience.
Extensive experience defining test objectives from requirements, writing Software Test Plans, test procedures, performing dry runs and Formal Qualification Tests, code inspections, performing post-processing analysis, writing Test Readiness Reviews and Test Reports.
Advanced hands‑on system troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis.
Experience working in a Lab environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Working experience in Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, etc.
Familiar with setting up test benches and using test equipment (Oscilloscopes, signal generators, etc.).
Experience working with requirements development.

Secondary Level Salary Range: $0.00 - $0.00

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
About The Company

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About This Role

We are seeking a Data Platform Software Engineer to design and implement the data acquisition, storage, and streaming backbone for test stands and production systems. This role sits at the intersection of industrial data systems and high-performance backend engineering, and is responsible for building reliable, scalable data pipelines that ingest high-throughput, high-channel-count sensor telemetry without loss and serve it to visualization and analytics layers. The successful candidate will play a central role in defining the architecture, schema design, and operational reliability of mission-critical data infrastructure.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput data pipelines for kHz-class, high-channel-count sensor telemetry across test and production environments.
Design and operate time-series storage and industrial data historians for long-term retention, query performance, and schema evolution.
Build ingestion and streaming services with a focus on buffering, backpressure, idempotency, and no silent data loss.
Define and champion modern software engineering practices, data architecture, schema standards, testing strategies, and operational best practices across the data platform.
Work closely with controls, test automation, and visualization teams to feed downstream analytics and live dashboards directly.
Lead debugging, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements across the full ingestion-to-storage stack.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience building data pipelines, streaming systems, or backend data infrastructure.
Strong, production-level experience in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with high-throughput data ingestion and time-series or historian storage, with a strong understanding of distributed systems and data reliability.
Experience with high-reliability, on-premise, 24/7 deployments in safety-critical environments.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience with time-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB), in-memory data stores (e.g., Redis), and OT/industrial data historians.
Experience with streaming and pub/sub middleware (e.g., MQTT, DDS, OPC-UA, Kafka).
Experience with high-channel-count sensor data and reliability engineering for ingestion.
Background in observability, infrastructure-as-code, and feeding visualization layers (e.g., Grafana).
Background in high-reliability or data-intensive environments (e.g., industrial automation, aerospace, energy, finance/trading, telecom, scientific research).
Demonstrated technical leadership in setting engineering standards, and building and mentoring high-performance engineering teams.

Additional Requirements

Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
Ability to come into our office every day. This role is 100% on site and in person.
Currently a US Citizen with capability to obtain and maintain a US Q clearance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation And Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $125,000–$220,000
annually.

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

Must be authorized to permanently work in United States

jobs.title: Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Geom is building an AI platform focused on production-scale architecture, helping homebuilders automate repetitive drafting, review, and construction-document workflows. Its technology integrates with the tools and plan sets builders already use, reducing manual effort and improving consistency. Backed by prominent technology investors, Geoms team combines deep expertise in architecture, homebuilding, AI, and startup environments. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and operates at the intersection of built environment and advanced machine learning. Additional information about Geom and its platform can be .

The Role

Were looking for a Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer to help build the intelligence behind Geom.

Youll work on challenging problems at the intersection of computer vision, multimodal AI, geometry, machine learning, and architectural data. The goal is not simply to recognize what appears in a drawing, but to understand the elements, relationships, constraints, and intent represented within complex architectural plan sets, and turn that understanding into reliable automation.

This is an early-stage role with the opportunity to make an impact. Youll work closely with our engineering, product, and architecture teams to take ideas from experimentation through production and apply them to real-world building plans at scale.

What Youll Work On

Develop models and systems for understanding architectural drawings, floor plans, construction documents, and other complex visual information.
Build computer vision and multimodal pipelines for detecting, classifying, extracting, and reasoning about architectural elements and their relationships.
Combine vision models, foundation models, geometric reasoning, and structured representations to create semantic understanding of plan sets.
Develop methods for matching and tracking elements across drawings, sheets, revisions, and plan variations.
Work on problems involving object detection, segmentation, document understanding, spatial reasoning, image registration, vector geometry, and visual similarity.
Design training, evaluation, and data-generation pipelines that allow models to improve rapidly as we encounter new plan types and workflows.
Develop practical approaches for working with imperfect, noisy, inconsistent, and highly variable real-world architectural data.
Translate experimental ML capabilities into reliable production systems.
Establish evaluation frameworks and metrics for model accuracy, reliability, and downstream automation quality.
Collaborate directly with domain experts to understand architectural conventions and convert that expertise into scalable technical systems.

What Were Looking For

Strong experience building and deploying machine learning or computer vision systems.
Deep understanding of modern computer vision techniques and neural network architectures.
Experience with one or more areas such as object detection, segmentation, document AI, multimodal models, vision-language models, image matching, geometry processing, or spatial reasoning.
Strong Python skills and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
Experience building datasets, training pipelines, evaluation systems, and production inference workflows.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to turn research ideas into maintainable production systems.
Comfort working on ambiguous problems where the right technical approach may need to be invented.
Ability to move quickly between experimentation, implementation, debugging, and deployment.
Excitement about working closely with a small, highly collaborative team in an early-stage environment.

You may be particularly well suited for this role if you have experience with:

Document understanding or document intelligence
CAD, architectural drawings, engineering drawings, maps, diagrams, or other structured visual documents
Vector graphics, computational geometry, graph representations, or spatial data
OCR and layout understanding
Image registration, feature matching, or correspondence
Numerical optimization
Synthetic data generation and data augmentation
Fine-tuning or adapting foundation models
Model evaluation and benchmarking for complex reasoning tasks
ML infrastructure and large-scale inference systems

Why Geom

Youll have the opportunity to work on AI problems that are both technically difficult and immediately connected to the physical world. Architectural plans contain an enormous amount of structured information, but much of the work required to interpret, modify, and produce them remains manual. Were building the intelligence layer that changes that. At Geom, youll have meaningful ownership from the beginning, work directly with experienced founders and domain experts, and help define a new technical category at the intersection of AI, architecture, and homebuilding.

Don't See a Perfect Match?

Great people rarely fit perfectly into a checklist. If youre excited about computer vision, multimodal AI, geometry, or building intelligent systems that understand the built environment, wed like to hear from you.

Compensation

Pursuant to applicable state and local pay transparency laws, the anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000$220,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Benefits

Health and dental insurance
Paid time off and holidays
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Remote work options (where applicable)

Geom is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, and what each person can bring to the team, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and modernize the enterprise applications that power Rooms To Go's supply chain. These systems support inventory planning, purchasing, replenishment, supplier collaboration, and operational decision-making, helping ensure the right products are available at the right place and time to meet customer demand.

This role is ideal for a software engineer with 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience who enjoys solving complex business challenges with scalable, reliable software. You'll partner closely with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, and Product teams to develop solutions that improve inventory availability, automate business processes, reduce operational costs, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Rather than building customer-facing websites or e-commerce features, you'll focus on the business-critical systems that keep our supply chain running efficiently and directly impact purchasing decisions, inventory flow, and the overall customer experience.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack supply chain applications using JavaScript, Vue.js and/or React, C#, and .NET Core.
Develop business applications that improve inventory availability, purchasing, replenishment, shipment planning, and overall supply chain efficiency.
Build and enhance software that automates business processes, streamlines workflows, reduces manual effort, and supports smarter purchasing decisions while reducing inventory shortages and operational costs.
Design and maintain backend APIs, business services, integrations, and application logic using C# and .NET Core.
Develop intuitive front-end applications that support inventory visibility, purchasing workflows, exception management, approvals, prioritization, reporting, and operational decision-making.
Design, maintain, and optimize relational databases and data models supporting products, vendors, inventory, purchase orders, sales demand, lead times, and fulfillment.
Integrate enterprise applications with ERP, warehouse management systems (WMS), supplier platforms, reporting tools, third-party systems, and internal business applications.
Collaborate with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, Sales, Product, QA, and Engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions.
Participate in application architecture, technical design, and code reviews, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term business objectives.
Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and knowledge sharing while promoting engineering best practices.
Create and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation, system architecture, data flows, implementation decisions, and deployment or support guides.
Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions that improve application stability and reliability.

Qualifications

5+ years of professional software development experience building full-stack, enterprise business applications.
Strong full-stack development experience with JavaScript, modern web frameworks (Vue.js and/or React), and backend development using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
Experience designing and developing backend APIs, business services, integrations, and data-driven applications.
Experience building and supporting enterprise software, internal business systems, operational platforms, workflow tools, dashboards, reporting applications, or similar business-critical solutions.
Strong understanding of relational databases, including data modeling, SQL queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and application data access patterns.
Experience translating complex business processes and workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions while supporting systems where accuracy, reliability, and business continuity are critical.
Strong understanding of API design, authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, logging, and secure coding best practices.
Experience with Git-based development workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to mentor other developers, contribute to technical decision-making, and produce clear technical documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to balance engineering quality, business priorities, operational urgency, and delivery timelines.

Supply Chain Experience

Direct supply chain experience is highly desirable but not required. The ideal candidate should be excited to learn and work within business domains such as:

Inventory management, including inventory availability, replenishment, purchasing, purchase order management, sales demand, demand planning, backorders, stockouts, lead times, fulfillment, and shipment prioritization.
Supply chain optimization, including cost reduction, process automation, and continuous improvement.
Enterprise supply chain technologies, including ERP, warehouse management systems (WMS), and integrations with internal and third-party business systems.
Operational decision support, including exception-based workflows, reporting, dashboards, and business process visibility.

Cloud, DevOps, and AI development tools, including Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitHub Copilot, Azure AI, or similar technologies.
Enterprise business systems, including ERP, WMS, supply chain, purchasing, inventory, order management, forecasting, replenishment, business process automation, reporting, analytics, and operational software.

Role and Scope of Position:
The Engineer will be part of the Advanced Modeling and Forecasting Team within the System Planning organization. This position focuses on advanced Synergi Electric modeling, special study modeling and MATLAB-based automation and model management capabilities.
A large portion of this role is dedicated to hands on Synergi Electric modeling and special studies, including capacity relief, contingency analysis, fault current analysis. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Build Our Future Together

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to join our Automation Engineering team to keep our groundbreaking process controls and process monitoring systems running at peak efficiency. In this role, you will build, develop, and optimize systems for our sophisticated biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with multiple teams to include Manufacturing, Quality Control, and Facilities. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

When & Where

Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States

Work model: On-site Monday - Friday 8:00AM - 4:30PM

Discover Your Role

Design, develop, and implement software and hardware improvements to automated and new equipment under change control.

Provide PLC- and HMI-based technical support to various departments per established SOPs.

Identify, investigate, and resolve manufacturing deviations tied to automated control systems.

Develop engineering design documents, technical evaluations, and test plans in line with GAMP 5.

Support process control and monitoring equipment through software design, commissioning, testing, and corrective action.

Support small manufacturing, engineering, and validation projects.

Author and execute Factory Acceptance Test and Site Acceptance Test protocols and system specifications.

Champion continuous improvement as an everyday outlook, not just a metric.

This Role Requires

BS in Engineering or a related field, with 2+ years of relevant experience; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Experience in the design and maintenance of process control and/or data acquisition systems is required.

Experience programming and troubleshooting the DeltaV DCS as well as PLCs. Experience with Allen-Bradley and Siemens control system products and video graphic chart recorders is ideal.

Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is ideal

Gowning And Physical Requirements

Full cleanroom attire (examples may include including laundered undergarments, gown, facemask, hairnet, safety glasses, safety shoes and booties, latex gloves and the use of sanitizing agents during gowning process including IPA)

Ability to remove jewelry, make-up and nail adornments when wearing cleanroom attire is required

jobs.description:
What To Expect

Full autonomy is of critical importance to Tesla's mission. As a member of TeslaSI’s Simulation team, you will be in a unique position to accelerate the pace at which Autopilot improves over time. The main ways in which the simulation team realizes this is through building tools that enable TeslaSI developers to perform virtual test drives instead of real ones, testing all Autopilot software releases for regressive behavior and generating synthetic data sets for neural network training.

The foundation on which we build these elements is our simulation environment. We develop photorealistic worlds for our virtual car to drive in, enabling our developers to iterate faster and rely less on real-world testing. We strive for perfect correlation to real-world vehicle behavior and work with TeslaSI Software Engineers to improve both Autopilot and the simulator over time. Our group is a cross-disciplinary team with people from various backgrounds and fields of expertise, like CS generalists, mechanical engineers, game developers, and computer graphics artists. As a member on this team, you will be challenged to learn about all these different disciplines and use your own expertise to further improve the scope and usability of our tools.

As a Simulation Engineer, you will contribute to the development of TeslaSI simulation by enabling and supporting the creation of photo realistic 3D scenes that can accurately model the driving experience in a wide range of locales and conditions.

What You'll Do

Contribute to the development of a modular, scalable simulation platform
Work with all members of the TeslaSI team to understand the simulation requirements and develop tools to meet those needs
Enhance the realism and performance of our in-house GPU ray tracer
Implement algorithms enabling real-time rendering of realistic scenes with complex lighting environments
Improve existing tools and features that enable the reproduction in Autopilot behavior in simulation

What You'll Bring

Extensive knowledge of light transport, appearance models, and color science
Experience researching, developing, and optimizing state of the art ray tracing techniques such as next even estimation (NEE), reservoir importance sampling (RIS), and multiple importance sampling (MIS)
Knowledge of modern graphics APIs and shader languages
Experience working with training frameworks and understanding of modern machine learning concepts
Experience with optimization across CPU and GPU
Confidence with modern C++
Experience with modern physically based rendering engines
Excellent mathematics skills, including proficiency with linear algebra, calculus, and probability
Deep understanding of tradeoffs in engine performance, scalability, and maintainability
Experience with supporting tools, such as exporters, terrain editors, and GPU debuggers

jobs.title: Scientific Software Developer for MPAS Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts.

As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Scientific Software Developer for MPAS Infrastructure
to join our growing team. The ideal Scientific Software Developer for MPAS Infrastructure will be local to the DC Metro area, and be able to work a hybrid schedule, working 2 days per week in office out of the College Park, MD location, and working from home the remaining 3 days of the week.

Duties of the Scientific Software Developer will include the following

Conduct infrastructure development and innovation for the seamless integration of MPAS (Model for Prediction Across Scales) as a new dynamical core (dycore) within the UFS Weather Model, along with necessary component updates and integration.
Develop, expand, and support NUOPC caps, coupling infrastructure, coupled field exchanges, component interactions, and mediator configurations to enable robust coupled model configurations using the MPAS dycore.
Develop new capabilities and modular frameworks to allow standalone testing of individual components within the coupled model.
Ensure portability of compiled code, build system configurations, and unit/regression testing workflows across scientific HPC platforms, including supporting the testing and integration of heterogeneous compute capabilities (e.g., GPUs).
Apply specialized tools for profiling parallel code at scale; identify performance bottlenecks (I/O, memory, load balancing); and investigate scalability algorithms suitable for refactoring, compression, or replacement with third-party implementations.
Build, maintain, debug, and refactor automated Continuous Integration (CI) workflows, and utilize modern Git-based code management and agile development practices (issues, pull requests, project boards).
Identify, evaluate, and apply generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, namely large language models (LLMs), to advance model development, focusing on the efficient generation of high-quality code and technical documentation.
Follow emerging trends in scientific HPC hardware, compilers, and software architectures to ensure the UFS model anticipates technological changes and utilizes state-of-the-art developments.
Serve as subject matter expert and technical point of contact for external model components (CICE, CDEPS), tracking external repository developments affecting the UFS Weather Model.
Engage and manage relationships with key UFS Weather Model stakeholders and application teams, serving as a point of contact and reviewing and integrating multi-team contributions.
Maintain a high standard of code documentation, rapidly troubleshoot build failures and runtime errors, demonstrate advanced debugging tools, and provide technical mentoring to colleagues.

The Scientific Software Developer selected should have the following

Candidates must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder to qualify (please indicate in your cover letter).
Background in meteorology/NWP, physical sciences, mathematics, computer science, software engineering, scientific computing, or a closely related field with demonstrated numerical modeling or closely related scientific computing experience.
Experience with or strong foundational understanding of Earth system or other dynamical modeling, with preference for the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) or other dynamical cores (dycores).
Demonstrated proficiency in Fortran (including F95+ and Object-Oriented concepts) and Python (including OOP and automation).
Proficiency in shell scripting (Bash) and developing scientific software within Linux or similar environments.
Demonstrated working knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including modular design, unit testing, and standalone component testing frameworks.
Experience developing, configuring, and executing parallel Earth system or similar models on HPC systems.
Working knowledge of parallel job schedulers (SLURM, PBS) on HPC systems.
Experience with CMake-based build systems and CTest; development experience strongly preferred.
Proficiency in Git-based (GitHub/GitLab) version control and code management, including branching/forking strategies, pull/merge requests, and issue/project tracking.
Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to advance code and documentation development, or willingness to learn.
Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
Ability to work effectively and professionally as part of a diverse, customer-focused team, collaborating with physical scientists, software engineers, and inter-agency partner teams.
Demonstrated ability to independently identify, prioritize, and implement bug fixes and new features.
Ability to provide technical mentorship to colleagues and maintain user-facing developer documentation.

The ideal Scientific Software Developer will have the following

Practical experience with coupled Earth system model frameworks (e.g., ESMF), NUOPC, mediators, and component interactions is strongly preferred, as well as experience developing and running individual components (atmosphere, ocean, wave, ice).
GPU and other heterogeneous computing experience or familiarity is a plus.
Experience in C++ is beneficial.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments is preferred.
Demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining continuous integration (CI) and other automated workflows is a plus.
Familiarity with package managers (e.g., Spack) and containerization technologies (Apptainer/Singularity, Docker/Podman) is beneficial.

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities - creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

Job Description

You will build and maintain the data pipelines that power a new suite of private credit analytics products. This means extracting data from large-scale loan administration systems, transforming it into analytics-ready structures, implementing incremental refresh logic for near-real-time delivery, and resolving entities across multiple sources. You own the "data in motion" layer — everything from source extraction through to landing clean, validated, reconciled data into the platform for downstream consumption.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Build & ETL: Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from core administration platforms into the analytics data model. Handle tens of thousands of live records with daily (or intraday) refresh requirements
Data Extraction & Transformation: Implement extraction logic for complex financial data — including loan balances (funded, unfunded, PIK, outstanding), rate structures (index, floor, spread, all-in), pro-rata allocations, utilisation calculations, and maturity dates
Incremental Refresh Logic: Implement change-data-capture (CDC) and incremental refresh patterns to deliver near-real-time data without full reloads. Critical for client-facing products where same-day freshness is expected
Supplementary Data Ingestion: Build pipelines to ingest and validate structured data from regulatory filings and third-party sources, de-duplicate against the primary dataset, and integrate into the master data layer
Data Quality & Monitoring: Implement automated quality checks — completeness, freshness, range validation, referential integrity, duplicate detection. Build alerting for pipeline failures and anomalies
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Architect (who defines the logical model and schema) and the Platform Engineer (who owns the infrastructure your pipelines run on) to ensure alignment between logical design, physical implementation, and delivery requirements

Requirements

5+ years of professional data engineering experience building production pipelines at scale
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL
Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt)
Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and CI/CD for data pipelines
Strong experience with CDC, streaming, or event-driven architectures
Solid understanding of data modelling — star schema, slowly changing dimensions, master data management
Experience in financial services data environments preferred

Desirable

Experience with regulatory filing ingestion and parsing (e.g., XBRL, HTML extraction from public filings)
Familiarity with loan-level data structures (credit agreements, facilities, tranches, pro-rata allocations)
Experience building pipelines that serve external commercial clients (not only internal BI)
Cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

Salary range:
We offer a salary of $87,500 to $145,000+ for this role. We encourage all interested candidates to apply and discuss their salary expectations and overall package with the recruitment team.

Our Global Benefits Also Include

Support for professional accreditations
Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
Continuous mentoring along your career progression
Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

(Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy-notice/)

Our client is seeking experienced and driven Front-End Software Engineers
and Senior Front-End Software Engineers
to join their team. In this hands-on engineering role, you will help modernize legacy application architectures, design scalable micro-frontends, and build high-performing, user-focused web applications for large-scale digital platforms. You will work across modern front-end technologies ( Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx

Design, develop, and scale responsive web applications using Angular (Angular 10+ to 20+/22), TypeScript, RxJS, and NgRx/Redux.
Architect and implement micro-frontend patterns, standalone components, feature modules, and shared design component libraries.
Modernize legacy front-end applications by refactoring outdated modules, eliminating anti-patterns, and adopting modern architectural standards.
Build and integrate front-end applications with Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and Java (Spring Boot) microservices and APIs.
Design clean API contracts and state integration layers using RxJS pipelines and HTTP interceptors.
Implement advanced Angular performance techniques (e.g., OnPush change detection, zoneless patterns, lazy loading, and route-level code splitting).
Drive test-first development and write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Cypress, Playwright, Jest, Storybook, or Jasmine/Karma.
Enhance CI/CD pipelines with automated linting, test validation, and build processes.
Support deployment strategies including A/B testing, feature toggles, and blue-green deployments across cloud platforms (e.g., AWS S3, CloudFront, Lambda).
Utilize Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code creation, testing, and documentation.
Participate in architecture reviews, troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and mentor junior/mid-level engineers (Senior level) .

8+ years of software development experience with proven expertise in technical design and front-end architecture.
Deep expertise in Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, and state management (NgRx, Redux, or Component Store).
Strong working knowledge of Node.js and/or NestJS for building supporting services or middleware.
Hands-on experience integrating front-end systems with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and microservices.
Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and micro-frontend architecture patterns.
Demonstrated proficiency with automated test frameworks (Cypress, Playwright, Jest, or Storybook).
Experience working with CI/CD automation and deployment workflows.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience collaborating with Java (Spring Boot) back-end service layers.
Familiarity with AWS cloud technologies (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway).
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows.
Domain knowledge in Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Deloitte is seeking a Data Engineer II to support the design, development, and delivery of data solutions that enable analytics, reporting, and business decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, system integration, and platform architecture, enabling seamless, secure, and scalable access to enterprise data and AI capabilities. The ideal candidate brings technical experience in data engineering, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across teams in a dynamic environment. The API Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and scaling the API-first consumption layer of the Data.State platform.

Work you'll do

As a Data Engineer II on the Data Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

Transform the data lake into a fully integrated, API-driven platform, supporting both traditional application consumption and emerging agent-to-agent (A2A) and model context protocol (MCP)-based interactions
Develop APIs exposing Databricks/ADLS data as services
Develop and optimize data models, integration patterns, and storage solutions to support analytics, reporting, and operational use cases
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define data requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement data quality controls
Build and support batch and near-real-time processing solutions using cloud-based and distributed data technologies
Document technical designs, data lineage, and deployment processes, and support testing, release, and production stabilization activities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

You will join a team that designs and delivers data engineering solutions that help organizations modernize data platforms and enable analytics, automation, and business insight. The team works across the data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, storage, quality, and delivery of data products. Team members collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to build scalable, reliable, and secure solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a quantitative field
3+ years of experience designing API development activities across design, implementation, testing, and maintenance
1+ years of experience using Python and SQL to conduct analysis and build ETL pipelines for production
1+ years of experience developing and deploying solutions on the Databricks platform
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must possess an active U.S. Secret security clearance and be able to maintain it for the duration of employment and assignment
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a quantitative field
Experience in cloud platform development and analytics (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $84,400 to $140,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III
jobs.description:
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.

Work You'll Do:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team:
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. DMCs mission is to cut the cycle time from concept to a manufacturable design by 10-100x. The founder brings 13 years leading hardware development at SpaceX, Relativity, and Lilium. DMC is proving this approach through a NASA SBIR Ignite Phase I program and commercial aerospace and defense work.

One-month paid working period, followed by a full-time offer.

Employee number one on the technical side.

The founder brings the product vision, hardware-development experience, and a tight feedback loop about what engineers need. This is a role that operates in an ambiguous chaotic environment and has significant growth potential.

The role is initially backend-focused, but the product is the unit of work, and front-end and deployment will be required. You will also be responsible for building the AI backbone of the software development process at DMC with the founder and will have significant leeway to build out the agentic coding tools required for us to scale.

Who We're Looking For

Backend depth with whole-product judgment. You have designed and shipped production systems, and you can move from a user problem to a data model, interface, runtime, deployment, and observable result. Python is the main language today but is one of many design decisions we will make together.
A relentless product builder. You take responsibility for understanding the forest from the trees, making forward progress in the presence of ambiguity, and iterating on the product to align with our customer needs.
Strong product and architecture judgment. You ask whether we are building the right thing before optimizing how we build it. Goal, not task oriented.
Exceptional use of agentic coding tools. You are at the leading edge of agentic software development. You are producing high-quality software that is operational, understandable, and scales. You have balance the balance of human judgment vs. agent execution. You can clearly communicate and accurately steer the impact of features, fixes, and problems identified by your agents.
Production experience LLM and agentic systems. You have a deep understanding of how to use, develop, and deploy LLM and agentic systems in mission critical applications.
Independent ownership and clear communication. You can work directly with a technical founder, turn an incomplete direction into a recommendation, explain tradeoffs in ordinary language, and show working behavior rather than reporting activity.

Background in a regulated industry such as aerospace, defense, medical technology, or financial technology
Prior early-stage startup experience

Location and arrangement

United States-based and a United States citizen.
Fully remote. Occasional Los Angeles-area meetings are a plus, not a requirement.
Full time, with flexibility and heavier periods around SBIR and customer milestones.
Asynchronous daily communication through Slack or a similar tool, three to five short meetings per week, and one weekly written summary.

Email with:

Your GitHub profile, resume, availability, and location.

A one-page brief on one project you personally drove.

Delivered as: a five minute or less, unedited screen recording showing the product, the relevant code, and one decision you made.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer I - Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.

With the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global and diverse community of colleagues with an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities and each other. Here, you’ll learn and grow as we help you create a career journey that’s unique and meaningful to you with benefits, programs, and flexibility that support you personally and professionally.

At American Express, you’ll be recognized for your contributions, leadership, and impact—every colleague has the opportunity to share in the company’s success. Together, we’ll win as a team, striving to uphold our company values and powerful backing promise to provide the world’s best customer experience every day. And we’ll do it with the utmost integrity, and in an environment where everyone is seen, heard and feels like they belong.

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

About Enterprise Architecture

Enterprise Architecture is an organization within the Core Technologies unit at American Express and it is a key enabler of the company’s architecture & technology strategy. The four pillars of Enterprise Architecture include:

Architecture as Code: this pillar owns and operates foundational technologies that are leveraged by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Architecture as Design: this pillar includes the solution and technical design for transformation programs and business critical projects which need architectural guidance and support.
Governance: this pillar is responsible for defining technical standards, and developing innovative tools that automate controls to ensure compliance.
Colleague Enablement: this pillar is focused on colleague development, recognition, training, and enterprise outreach.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer I to help design, build and operate the enterprise integration and event-driven platforms that connect American Express systems at scale. This is a hands-on senior engineering role, and you will own architecture solution, tooling and delivery for high-throughput, low-latency user interfaces & APIs & backend databases design & development in multi-region production environments, and you will set the technical direction that other engineers build against.

Responsibilities

Design, build and manage enterprise platforms and shared technology services for messaging, event distribution and system-to-system integration used by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Design and build the operator-facing surfaces for these platforms: self-service onboarding portals, topic and schema management consoles, and flow monitoring views, owning the full stack from the UI components through the APIs that back them.
Architect high-throughput, low-latency event-driven systems using publish/subscribe, queue-based and streaming patterns, and define the topic taxonomies, message contracts and canonical schemas that govern them.
Lead platform modernization and migration work — moving producers and consumers off legacy middleware and monolithic app servers onto containerized, cloud-native microservices with phased roadmaps, parallel-run validation, reconciliation and zero-outage cutovers.
Engineer resiliency into the platform: multi-region active-active topologies, endpoint failover, dead-letter handling, duplicate detection, and failure isolation so one flow cannot degrade another.

About The Company

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About This Role

new_jobs.title: Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Geom is building an AI platform focused on production-scale architecture, helping homebuilders automate repetitive drafting, review, and construction-document workflows. Its technology integrates with the tools and plan sets builders already use, reducing manual effort and improving consistency. Backed by prominent technology investors, Geoms team combines deep expertise in architecture, homebuilding, AI, and startup environments. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and operates at the intersection of built environment and advanced machine learning. Additional information about Geom and its platform can be .

The Role

Were looking for a Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer to help build the intelligence behind Geom.

Youll work on challenging problems at the intersection of computer vision, multimodal AI, geometry, machine learning, and architectural data. The goal is not simply to recognize what appears in a drawing, but to understand the elements, relationships, constraints, and intent represented within complex architectural plan sets, and turn that understanding into reliable automation.

This is an early-stage role with the opportunity to make an impact. Youll work closely with our engineering, product, and architecture teams to take ideas from experimentation through production and apply them to real-world building plans at scale.

What Youll Work On

Develop models and systems for understanding architectural drawings, floor plans, construction documents, and other complex visual information.
Build computer vision and multimodal pipelines for detecting, classifying, extracting, and reasoning about architectural elements and their relationships.
Combine vision models, foundation models, geometric reasoning, and structured representations to create semantic understanding of plan sets.
Develop methods for matching and tracking elements across drawings, sheets, revisions, and plan variations.
Work on problems involving object detection, segmentation, document understanding, spatial reasoning, image registration, vector geometry, and visual similarity.
Design training, evaluation, and data-generation pipelines that allow models to improve rapidly as we encounter new plan types and workflows.
Develop practical approaches for working with imperfect, noisy, inconsistent, and highly variable real-world architectural data.
Translate experimental ML capabilities into reliable production systems.
Establish evaluation frameworks and metrics for model accuracy, reliability, and downstream automation quality.
Collaborate directly with domain experts to understand architectural conventions and convert that expertise into scalable technical systems.

What Were Looking For

Strong experience building and deploying machine learning or computer vision systems.
Deep understanding of modern computer vision techniques and neural network architectures.
Experience with one or more areas such as object detection, segmentation, document AI, multimodal models, vision-language models, image matching, geometry processing, or spatial reasoning.
Strong Python skills and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
Experience building datasets, training pipelines, evaluation systems, and production inference workflows.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to turn research ideas into maintainable production systems.
Comfort working on ambiguous problems where the right technical approach may need to be invented.
Ability to move quickly between experimentation, implementation, debugging, and deployment.
Excitement about working closely with a small, highly collaborative team in an early-stage environment.

You may be particularly well suited for this role if you have experience with:

Document understanding or document intelligence
CAD, architectural drawings, engineering drawings, maps, diagrams, or other structured visual documents
Vector graphics, computational geometry, graph representations, or spatial data
OCR and layout understanding
Image registration, feature matching, or correspondence
Numerical optimization
Synthetic data generation and data augmentation
Fine-tuning or adapting foundation models
Model evaluation and benchmarking for complex reasoning tasks
ML infrastructure and large-scale inference systems

Why Geom

Youll have the opportunity to work on AI problems that are both technically difficult and immediately connected to the physical world. Architectural plans contain an enormous amount of structured information, but much of the work required to interpret, modify, and produce them remains manual. Were building the intelligence layer that changes that. At Geom, youll have meaningful ownership from the beginning, work directly with experienced founders and domain experts, and help define a new technical category at the intersection of AI, architecture, and homebuilding.

Don't See a Perfect Match?

new_jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and modernize the enterprise applications that power Rooms To Go's supply chain. These systems support inventory planning, purchasing, replenishment, supplier collaboration, and operational decision-making, helping ensure the right products are available at the right place and time to meet customer demand.

This role is ideal for a software engineer with 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience who enjoys solving complex business challenges with scalable, reliable software. You'll partner closely with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, and Product teams to develop solutions that improve inventory availability, automate business processes, reduce operational costs, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Rather than building customer-facing websites or e-commerce features, you'll focus on the business-critical systems that keep our supply chain running efficiently and directly impact purchasing decisions, inventory flow, and the overall customer experience.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack supply chain applications using JavaScript, Vue.js and/or React, C#, and .NET Core.
Develop business applications that improve inventory availability, purchasing, replenishment, shipment planning, and overall supply chain efficiency.
Build and enhance software that automates business processes, streamlines workflows, reduces manual effort, and supports smarter purchasing decisions while reducing inventory shortages and operational costs.
Design and maintain backend APIs, business services, integrations, and application logic using C# and .NET Core.
Develop intuitive front-end applications that support inventory visibility, purchasing workflows, exception management, approvals, prioritization, reporting, and operational decision-making.
Design, maintain, and optimize relational databases and data models supporting products, vendors, inventory, purchase orders, sales demand, lead times, and fulfillment.
Integrate enterprise applications with ERP, warehouse management systems (WMS), supplier platforms, reporting tools, third-party systems, and internal business applications.
Collaborate with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, Sales, Product, QA, and Engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions.
Participate in application architecture, technical design, and code reviews, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term business objectives.
Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and knowledge sharing while promoting engineering best practices.
Create and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation, system architecture, data flows, implementation decisions, and deployment or support guides.
Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions that improve application stability and reliability.

Qualifications

5+ years of professional software development experience building full-stack, enterprise business applications.
Strong full-stack development experience with JavaScript, modern web frameworks (Vue.js and/or React), and backend development using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
Experience designing and developing backend APIs, business services, integrations, and data-driven applications.
Experience building and supporting enterprise software, internal business systems, operational platforms, workflow tools, dashboards, reporting applications, or similar business-critical solutions.
Strong understanding of relational databases, including data modeling, SQL queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and application data access patterns.
Experience translating complex business processes and workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions while supporting systems where accuracy, reliability, and business continuity are critical.
Strong understanding of API design, authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, logging, and secure coding best practices.
Experience with Git-based development workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to mentor other developers, contribute to technical decision-making, and produce clear technical documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to balance engineering quality, business priorities, operational urgency, and delivery timelines.

Supply Chain Experience

Direct supply chain experience is highly desirable but not required. The ideal candidate should be excited to learn and work within business domains such as:

Inventory management, including inventory availability, replenishment, purchasing, purchase order management, sales demand, demand planning, backorders, stockouts, lead times, fulfillment, and shipment prioritization.
Supply chain optimization, including cost reduction, process automation, and continuous improvement.
Enterprise supply chain technologies, including ERP, warehouse management systems (WMS), and integrations with internal and third-party business systems.
Operational decision support, including exception-based workflows, reporting, dashboards, and business process visibility.

Preferred Experience

Cloud, DevOps, and AI development tools, including Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitHub Copilot, Azure AI, or similar technologies.
Enterprise business systems, including ERP, WMS, supply chain, purchasing, inventory, order management, forecasting, replenishment, business process automation, reporting, analytics, and operational software.
Modern application architecture, including microservices, service-oriented architecture (SOA), Docker, containerized applications, and enterprise application development.
Application monitoring, modernization, and integration, including Application Insights, Datadog, New Relic, modernizing legacy .NET applications, and integrating with third-party systems and APIs.
